local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{{{-66717.390625, 92723.578125, 14298.0}}, {{-66442.03125, 92596.015625, 14198.0}}, {{-66193.796875, 92548.71875, 14184.0}}, {{-65845.8984375, 92421.2890625, 14204.0}}, {{-65307.5625, 92539.8125, 14184.0}}, {{-65003.28125, 92568.03125, 14184.0}}, {{-64752.3125, 92300.265625, 14184.0}}, {{-64731.38671875, 92111.96875, 14184.0}}, {{-64640, 91990, 14184}}}}
local index=10
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.05 then return end;timer=0
 print('TownGate tamriel='..tostring(self.cell.worldSpaceId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3c))..' cell='..self.cell.name..' world='..tostring(self.cell.worldSpaceId))
 local target
 if index<=9 then
  local p=points[index];target=util.vector3(p[1],p[2],p[3])
  local d=target-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then print('TownGate reached='..index);index=index+1;return end
 else
  local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x2d89))
  if not door or not door:isValid() then return end
  target=door.position+util.vector3(0,0,30)
 end
 local d=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=camera.getPitch()
 if index>9 then local v=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(v.z,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<0.015 and (index<=9 or math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.02) then print('TownGate ready='..index) end
 print(string.format('TownGate aim x=%d y=%d step=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-200,math.min(200,math.floor(angle*512+.5))),math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)))
end}}}}
